fields.description: Issue includes commentary and satire tied to Miami’s Palm Fete and visiting editors, with items set at the Royal Palm Hotel and around Miami Beach. Articles discuss Congressman Wallace Dempsey’s remarks on Miami and Hollywood harbor development, Gene Tunney’s comments on Miami as a restful destination, and anecdotes involving prominent editors (including William Allen White). Local civic and business concerns include counterfeit/unsafe liquor sold as Bacardi and calls to report bootleggers, dock and freight-shipping constraints, banking and prosperity, and local firms excluded from an upcoming Miami Coliseum food exhibition. The issue also contains society-style columns, advertisements, and entertainment listings.
